attempts.rationale: The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability, so a weighted combination based on inverse error should help.
trend_dominated and moderate ranking stability suggest a simple mean may offer a different aggregation baseline.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a DBA (dynamic bagging) may adapt to horizon differences.
Test a robust aggregation (median) to see if a different kind of combination improves over weighted, given trend-dominated but moderate stability.
Test a weighted strategy using softmax of negative error to see if it outperforms inverse_error in this trend-dominated, moderately stable series.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability, so a trimmed‑mean may reduce influence of the top‑error models while still using many models.
test a weighted combination using the per‑horizon top‑k mean handle (w4) to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over global weighted mean.
Use per‑horizon weighted top‑k (k=3) to exploit horizon‑varying strengths; the series is trend‑dominated but some models differ by horizon.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted combination on a smaller, highly accurate pool (pool4) may exploit complementary strengths and reduce variance.
test a simple mean on the trend‑dominant pool4 to see if a non‑weighted aggregate can beat the weighted leader.
test a weighted combination on the full pool using inverse error weights (w1) to see if including more models improves the leader, given trend dominance and moderate ranking stability.
Test a weighted combination on pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if it can improve on the current best weighted softmax result.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4494. Series context: trend strength 0.9559 and seasonal strength 0.0922; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.423); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 15.258.
